Mixed purées

Spring vegetables with cauliflower

Tavaszi zöldség karfiollal

6 months+ Adjusted 30 min 4 portions

Serve from six months with no stock. Add cheese only if milk is already accepted, and then it becomes a milk allergen.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 140 g potato (peeled weight)
  • 60 g peas (fresh or frozen)
  • 80 g zucchini (peeled)
  • 50 g asparagus (tender part only, cooked very soft)
  • 80 g cauliflower (chopped fine)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Peel the potato and zucchini, snap woody ends off the asparagus, and chop the cauliflower fine.
  2. Cook potato, zucchini, asparagus, and cauliflower in unsalted water until very soft.
  3. Add the peas and cook until they squash easily.
  4. Blend until smooth.
  5. Do not add a stock cube or salt.
  6. Leave cheese out; a teaspoon of it would add a milk allergen, and the base has none.

Adjusted

Salty stock is often used and is not needed. The same plate is sometimes delayed until 10 months for no good reason.

Cook potato, pea, zucchini, and very soft asparagus, with cauliflower chopped fine, and use no stock. Serve from 6 months, and add cheese only as an option because a teaspoon would bring in a milk allergen the base does not have.
